annotation.bound_parties_text: A person who operates a platoon must notify the department of transportation and department of safety, and commercial motor vehicles in a platoon must have an endorsed commercial license driver behind the wheel.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: A person may operate a platoon on the streets and highways of this state after the person provides notification to the department of transportation and the department of safety.
annotation.dates_quote: This act shall take effect upon becoming a law, the public welfare requiring it.
